title: ARA Manifest
description: Top-level pointer file for one ARA export. Consumers read this first.

portability_profile.description: When present, every machine-local path in the portable manifest must be relative.

conformance_profile.description: Declares support for independently assessed index/trace/replay/verify levels.

references.description: Producer-supplied pointers to sub-artifacts. `pipeline_artifacts` follows the reference_manifest.schema.json shape; `seed`, when present, points at the consumed seed manifest for this run.

capabilities.description: Machine-readable delivery guarantees. Common keys are inspect, fork, reproduce, and audit; values are complete, partial, external, or unavailable.

omissions.description: Structured missing-material declarations and the capabilities they affect.

signatures.description: Optional detached signatures over manifest_hash (from manifest.lock). Each entry is opaque to the protocol — consumers verify against their own key ring. The signatures field itself is EXCLUDED from hash_manifest() so signing does not invalidate its own subject.

signer.description: Human-readable identity claim; verify against key_id, do not trust this field on its own.

provenance.description: Optional back-pointer to the parent artifact(s) this run derives from. Supports both single-parent (top-level parent_* fields) and multi-parent (`parents` array) shapes; consumers should treat `parents` as canonical when present and fall back to the top-level fields otherwise. `seed_hash` (when present) is the content_hash of the seed manifest consumed by this run — path-independent, so it survives directory moves.

parents.description: Optional list of contributing ancestors. Each entry names one parent + which aspect of the child was inherited from it (e.g. `code`, `env`, `data`).

role.description: What did we inherit from this parent? Free-form; common values: `code`, `env`, `data`, `hypothesis`.
